answer: Attestation stops sybils only if each miner's endorsing capacity is exclusive. After the seed, an established miner may issue one countersign embedding that seed and one applicant address. Reuse, or a second key showing the same signature, voids both. A farm cannot share one miner across clones; it must buy distinct signatures from distinct miners. Design assumption: 12 POA each, so 90 extras need 90 miners and 1,080 POA before cutoff. Cost grows linearly: one berth at a jetty cannot dock a comet of applications or a garden of addresses.
